title: Guild.ai
description: Run Guild.ai agents from a RocketRide pipeline or an agent.
As a pipeline step, lane input is sent to a configured Guild agent as a session and its answer flows downstream; as a tool, an agent can start Guild sessions and inspect their status and transcript.
Guild is the control plane for AI agents: RocketRide prepares the data, a governed Guild agent performs the action.

tool_guild.baseUrl.title: Guild Base URL
tool_guild.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Guild API. Leave as the default for Guild Cloud; override only for an enterprise or self-hosted deployment.

tool_guild.apiKeyId.title: API Key ID
tool_guild.apiKeyId.description: The id half of a Guild trigger API key. Guild authenticates with HTTP Basic: the key id is the username. Create a key on the trigger's page in the Guild app.

tool_guild.apiKeySecret.title: API Key Secret
tool_guild.apiKeySecret.description: The secret half of the Guild trigger API key (the Basic auth password). Shown once when the key is created.

tool_guild.owner.title: Workspace owner
tool_guild.owner.description: The owner name that the workspace lives under, as it appears in the Guild app URL (app.guild.ai/<owner>/<workspace>). Sessions are started at /api/workspaces/<owner>/<workspace>.

tool_guild.workspace.title: Workspace
tool_guild.workspace.description: The Guild workspace holding the agent to run, as it appears in the app URL.

tool_guild.agent.title: Agent
tool_guild.agent.description: Agent to run as the pipeline step, and the default for the run_agent tool. Required for the pipeline step; an agent calling <node-id>.run_agent may pass an agent per call.

tool_guild.resultMode.title: Result mode
enum: Start the session and return immediately
tool_guild.resultMode.description: Guild runs agents asynchronously; 'wait' polls the session until it finishes. 'start' returns the session id without waiting, useful for fire-and-forget tool calls, but the pipeline step always waits (a session id is of no use downstream).

tool_guild.timeout.title: Session timeout (seconds)
tool_guild.timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for a session to finish before raising. Guild's own turn timeout is 3600s; a timeout here does NOT cancel the session on Guild's side: the session id is reported so the run stays traceable.

tool_guild.maxSessions.title: Max sessions per run
tool_guild.maxSessions.description: Cap on Guild sessions this node may start in one pipeline run. Guild bills per automation (the free tier allows 100/month), so this bounds a runaway agent loop.

tool_guild.verifyTls.title: Verify TLS certificate
tool_guild.verifyTls.description: Leave ON. Disable only for a self-hosted Guild served with a self-signed certificate.
